name: LanDeng Chinese Botanical Incense Ingredient Encyclopedia
description: Machine-readable definitions of the botanical ingredients in the LanDeng (澜灯) Chinese incense encyclopedia. Chinese terms are the source of truth; English is the agreed translation.

mainEntity.name: Agarwood
mainEntity.description: 沉香 (chénxiāng) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Aquilaria spp. — with an aroma profile of woody, resinous, sweet, complex.

mainEntity.name: Benzoin
alternateName: Styrax tonkinensis (Siam); Styrax benzoin / S. paralleloneurus (Sumatra)
mainEntity.description: 安息香 (ānxīxiāng) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Styrax tonkinensis (Siam); Styrax benzoin / S. paralleloneurus (Sumatra) — with an aroma profile of sweet, vanilla, balsamic, woody.

additionalProperty.name: Scientific name
additionalProperty.value: Styrax tonkinensis (Siam); Styrax benzoin / S. paralleloneurus (Sumatra)

mainEntity.name: Cedar
alternateName: Cedrus spp. (true cedar); note 'cedarwood' often = Juniperus virginiana
mainEntity.description: 雪松 (xuěsōng) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Cedrus spp. (true cedar); note 'cedarwood' often = Juniperus virginiana — with an aroma profile of woody, clean, slightly sweet.

additionalProperty.name: Scientific name
additionalProperty.value: Cedrus spp. (true cedar); note 'cedarwood' often = Juniperus virginiana

mainEntity.name: Chrysanthemum
mainEntity.description: 菊花 (júhuā) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Chrysanthemum morifolium (and C. indicum) — with an aroma profile of floral, herbal, bittersweet.

mainEntity.name: Cinnamon
alternateName: Cinnamomum cassia (Chinese cinnamon/cassia); cf. C. verum (Ceylon cinnamon)
mainEntity.description: 桂皮 (guìpí) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Cinnamomum cassia (Chinese cinnamon/cassia); cf. C. verum (Ceylon cinnamon) — with an aroma profile of warm, spicy, sweet.

additionalProperty.name: Scientific name
additionalProperty.value: Cinnamomum cassia (Chinese cinnamon/cassia); cf. C. verum (Ceylon cinnamon)

mainEntity.name: Clove
mainEntity.description: 丁香 (dīngxiāng) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Syzygium aromaticum — with an aroma profile of spicy, warm, aromatic.

mainEntity.name: Frankincense
alternateName: Boswellia spp. (B. sacra, B. serrata, B. carterii)
mainEntity.description: 乳香 (rǔxiāng) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Boswellia spp. (B. sacra, B. serrata, B. carterii) — with an aroma profile of resinous, citrus, earthy, creamy.

additionalProperty.name: Scientific name
additionalProperty.value: Boswellia spp. (B. sacra, B. serrata, B. carterii)

mainEntity.name: Jasmine
mainEntity.description: 茉莉 (mòlì) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Jasminum sambac (and other Jasminum spp.) — with an aroma profile of sweet, floral, heady.

mainEntity.name: Mugwort
mainEntity.description: 艾草 (àicǎo) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Artemisia spp. (A. argyi, A. vulgaris) — with an aroma profile of herbal, bitter-green, camphoraceous.

mainEntity.name: Myrrh
mainEntity.description: 没药 (mòyào) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Commiphora myrrha (and other Commiphora spp.) — with an aroma profile of balsamic, earthy, bitter, medicinal.

mainEntity.name: Orange Peel / Chenpi
mainEntity.description: 陈皮 (chénpí) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Citrus reticulata (aged mandarin/tangerine peel) — with an aroma profile of citrus, bittersweet, woody.

mainEntity.name: Osmanthus
mainEntity.description: 桂花 (guìhuā) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Osmanthus fragrans — with an aroma profile of sweet, floral, apricot, honey.

mainEntity.name: Patchouli
mainEntity.description: 广藿香 (guǎnghuòxiāng) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Pogostemon cablin — with an aroma profile of earthy, woody, balsamic, spicy.

mainEntity.name: Rose
alternateName: Rosa rugosa (Chinese rose); also Rosa damascena
mainEntity.description: 玫瑰 (méiguī) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Rosa rugosa (Chinese rose); also Rosa damascena — with an aroma profile of sweet, floral, romantic.

additionalProperty.name: Scientific name
additionalProperty.value: Rosa rugosa (Chinese rose); also Rosa damascena

mainEntity.name: Sandalwood
mainEntity.description: 檀香 (tánxiāng) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Santalum album (and other Santalum spp.) — with an aroma profile of creamy, sweet, soft, woody.

mainEntity.name: Vetiver
mainEntity.description: 岩兰草 (yánláncǎo) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Chrysopogon zizanioides (syn. Vetiveria zizanioides) — with an aroma profile of earthy, woody, smoky, warm.

mainEntity.name: Borneol
alternateName: Dryobalanops aromatica (d-borneol); Blumea balsamifera (l-borneol); synthetic borneol
mainEntity.description: 龙脑 (lóngnǎo) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — borneol (Dryobalanops aromatica d-borneol; Blumea balsamifera l-borneol; plus synthetic) — with an aroma profile of camphoraceous, cooling, minty, woody.

additionalProperty.name: Scientific name
additionalProperty.value: Dryobalanops aromatica (d-borneol); Blumea balsamifera (l-borneol); synthetic borneol

mainEntity.name: Pine Resin
mainEntity.description: 松香 (sōngxiāng) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — pine oleoresin (Pinus spp., rosin/colophony) — with an aroma profile of piney, woody, balsamic, resinous.

additionalProperty.name: Scientific name
additionalProperty.value: Pinus spp. (rosin / colophony from pine oleoresin)

mainEntity.name: Angelica
mainEntity.description: 白芷 (báizhǐ) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Angelica dahurica (the dried root) — with an aroma profile of herbal, aromatic, sweet-bitter, slightly spicy.

mainEntity.name: Calamus
mainEntity.description: 菖蒲 (chāngpú) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Acorus calamus (the rhizome) — with an aroma profile of herbal, spicy, sweet, earthy. Note: calamus oil can contain β-asarone, restricted in food use in some jurisdictions.

mainEntity.name: Sweetgum
mainEntity.description: 枫香 (fēngxiāng) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Liquidambar formosana resin (cf. L. orientalis storax) — with an aroma profile of sweet, balsamic, resinous, warm.

additionalProperty.name: Scientific name
additionalProperty.value: Liquidambar formosana (Chinese sweetgum); cf. L. orientalis (storax)

mainEntity.name: Ambergris
mainEntity.description: 龙涎香 (lóngxiánxiāng) is a Chinese incense ingredient (animal-derived, not botanical) — ambergris, a sperm whale (Physeter macrocephalus) secretion — with an aroma profile of marine, sweet, earthy, waxy. Most 'ambergris' today is synthetic.

additionalProperty.name: Scientific name
additionalProperty.value: Physeter macrocephalus (sperm whale) — animal-derived, not botanical

mainEntity.name: Agastache
mainEntity.description: 藿香 (huòxiāng) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Agastache rugosa — with an aroma profile of minty, herbal, sweet, anise-like.

mainEntity.name: Atractylodes
mainEntity.description: 苍术 (cāngzhú) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Atractylodes lancea — with an aroma profile of herbal, woody, pungent, earthy.

mainEntity.name: Borneol Oil
alternateName: Dryobalanops aromatica (Borneo camphor tree); also Cinnamomum camphora
mainEntity.description: 龙脑油 (lóngnǎo yóu) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Dryobalanops aromatica (Borneo camphor tree); also Cinnamomum camphora — with an aroma profile of camphoraceous, cooling, balsamic, woody.

additionalProperty.name: Scientific name
additionalProperty.value: Dryobalanops aromatica (Borneo camphor tree); also Cinnamomum camphora

mainEntity.name: Cardamom
mainEntity.description: 白豆蔻 (báidòukòu) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Amomum kravanh (white/round cardamom) — with an aroma profile of camphoraceous, spicy, eucalyptus, warm.

mainEntity.name: Cyperus
mainEntity.description: 香附子 (xiāngfùzǐ) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Cyperus rotundus — with an aroma profile of woody, spicy, earthy, smoky.

mainEntity.name: Jiangzhenxiang
alternateName: Acronychia pedunculata (classical); cf. Dalbergia odorifera (modern conflation)
mainEntity.description: 降真香 (jiàngzhēnxiāng) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Acronychia pedunculata (classical); cf. Dalbergia odorifera (modern conflation) — with an aroma profile of woody, sweet, resinous, subtle.

additionalProperty.name: Scientific name
additionalProperty.value: Acronychia pedunculata (classical); cf. Dalbergia odorifera (modern conflation)

mainEntity.name: Linglingxiang
mainEntity.description: 零陵香 (línglíngxiāng) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Lysimachia foenum-graecum — with an aroma profile of sweet, hay-like, herbaceous, coumarin.

mainEntity.name: Orris Root
alternateName: Iris germanica / I. pallida (orris); cf. Iris tectorum (Chinese iris)
mainEntity.description: 鸢尾根 (yuānwěi gēn) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Iris germanica / I. pallida (orris); cf. Iris tectorum (Chinese iris) — with an aroma profile of powdery, floral, violet, woody.

additionalProperty.name: Scientific name
additionalProperty.value: Iris germanica / I. pallida (orris); cf. Iris tectorum (Chinese iris)

mainEntity.name: Plum Blossom
mainEntity.description: 梅花 (méihuā) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Prunus mume (syn. Armeniaca mume) — with an aroma profile of delicate, sweet, almondy, green-floral.

mainEntity.name: Spikenard
mainEntity.description: 甘松 (gānsōng) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Nardostachys jatamansi — with an aroma profile of earthy, woody, sweet, musky.

mainEntity.name: Star Anise
mainEntity.description: 八角 (bājiǎo) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Illicium verum — with an aroma profile of sweet, licorice, warm, spicy.

mainEntity.name: Storax
mainEntity.description: 苏合香 (sūhéxiāng) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Liquidambar orientalis (Oriental sweetgum / storax) — with an aroma profile of sweet, balsamic, resinous, warm.

mainEntity.name: Red Sandalwood
mainEntity.description: 紫檀 (zǐtán) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Pterocarpus santalinus — with an aroma profile of woody, sweet, rosy, spicy.

mainEntity.name: Camphor
mainEntity.description: 樟木 (zhāngmù) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Cinnamomum camphora — with an aroma profile of camphoraceous, cooling, woody, fresh.

mainEntity.name: Fennel
mainEntity.description: 小茴香 (xiǎohuíxiāng) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Foeniculum vulgare — with an aroma profile of sweet, anise, warm, herbaceous.

mainEntity.name: Eupatorium
mainEntity.description: 佩兰 (pèilán) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Eupatorium fortunei — with an aroma profile of herbal, aromatic, sweet, fresh.

mainEntity.name: Ligusticum
mainEntity.description: 藁本 (gǎoběn) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Ligusticum sinense — with an aroma profile of herbal, aromatic, spicy, woody.

mainEntity.name: Citronella
mainEntity.description: 香茅 (xiāngmáo) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Cymbopogon citratus — with an aroma profile of citrusy, lemony, fresh, grassy.

mainEntity.name: Gardenia
mainEntity.description: 栀子花 (zhīzihuā) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Gardenia jasminoides — with an aroma profile of sweet, creamy, white-floral, heady.

mainEntity.name: Champaca
mainEntity.description: 白兰花 (báilánhuā) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Michelia alba (syn. Magnolia × alba) — with an aroma profile of sweet, floral, fruity, heady.

mainEntity.name: Nutmeg
mainEntity.description: 肉豆蔻 (ròudòukòu) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Myristica fragrans — with an aroma profile of warm, spicy, sweet, woody.

mainEntity.name: Sand Ginger
mainEntity.description: 山柰 (shānnài) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Kaempferia galanga — with an aroma profile of camphoraceous, spicy, earthy, floral.

mainEntity.name: Costus
alternateName: Saussurea costus (syn. Dolomiaea costus, Aucklandia lappa)
mainEntity.description: 木香 (mùxiāng) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Saussurea costus (syn. Dolomiaea costus, Aucklandia lappa) — with an aroma profile of earthy, woody, musky, animalic.

additionalProperty.name: Scientific name
additionalProperty.value: Saussurea costus (syn. Dolomiaea costus, Aucklandia lappa)

mainEntity.name: Cypress Seed
mainEntity.description: 柏子 (bǎizǐ) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Platycladus orientalis — with an aroma profile of roasted, nutty, woody, resinous.
